fusions.name: Cold Links Fall
fusions.desc: Drops a heavy mesh of cold linked rings over a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 30 damage to everything in it plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving each [Leaden] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Clinking Snag
fusions.desc: Snags the target in a short jab of ring-linked mesh, dealing 5 damage and leaving it 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Mail of Mesh
fusions.desc: Draws a mesh of linked rings over yourself, raising your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Unyielding Rings
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, your mesh of linked rings closes around you as a ward that absorbs 10% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
